description: This file defines a ConsoleAPI class that provides methods to interact with the browser's console, including querying elements, inspecting, generating locators, and taking ARIA snapshots. It also defines a Locator class for element selection and filtering.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: A class for constructing and filtering element locators with various selector options and combinators.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the Playwright-related functions into the window object if not already present.

methods.name: _querySelector
methods.description: Queries a single element based on a selector string with strictness option.

methods.name: _querySelectorAll
methods.description: Queries all elements matching a selector string.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Inspects an element in the browser's developer tools.

methods.name: _selector
methods.description: Generates a selector string for a given element.

methods.name: _generateLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator object for a given element and language.

methods.name: _resume
methods.description: Resumes execution if a resume function is available.
